propositions: The structural guard in test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py scans only transport.py for uncapped search_issues calls, but commit 465d moved all such calls to _base.py and _issues.py, leaving the guard scanning an empty file.
The guard predicate now returns zero offenders unconditionally and cannot detect new unpaginated search_issues calls added anywhere in the DC adapter.

Widening the scan from transport.py to the entire adapters/jira_datacenter/ directory with a non-vacuity assertion will restore the guard's ability to catch regressions and prevent future rot from module moves.
Both existing search_issues call sites already pass explicit maxResults caps and will pass the widened guard immediately upon scope expansion.
A full audit of tests/ found four additional single-file AST guards vacuously emptied by the same module-split mechanism and filed separately as ticket 8a5e.
